title: Gold after an AUD/JPY carry crash day

rule.signal: AUD/JPY daily return beyond 1.5 x the sd of the 20 returns before the day (crash = down, rally = up)
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys
rule.baseline: same-side trade after every eligible day of the same calendar year

tests.what: carry crash (AUD/JPY down > 1.5 sd): buy gold, hold 5 days (primary)
carry rally (AUD/JPY up > 1.5 sd): sell gold, hold 5 days
carry crash (AUD/JPY down > 1.5 sd): buy gold, hold 10 days
